basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Describes type-level composition, which components and how many, not the as-built structure of a serial unit.
Records occurrences with quantities, units, effectivity and alternates, which a design record does not.
Differs from a manufacturing BOM and routing, which add production steps, scrap and plant-specific items.
Differs from a software BOM, which lists software components and licences.

may: Resolve one applicable baseline for a given effectivity and configuration.
Expand the composition tree with loop protection and report withheld branches.
Compute rolled-up quantities when units are compatible and alternates are excluded.
Draft change proposals and where-used reports.
mustNot: Sum alternates or mix incompatible units in a roll-up.
Edit a released BOM revision in place.
Treat the BOM as authority to order material or start manufacturing.
Flatten distinct occurrences into one line when their identity matters for traceability.
Disclose supplier-confidential parts lists beyond the declared scope.
requiresHuman: Releasing a BOM revision or engineering change.
Approving substitutes or alternates for safety-relevant components.

considerations: BOM errors can introduce unsafe or counterfeit components into products people rely on.
Composition data supports material disclosure duties, such as restricted substances, and should stay accurate.
Supplier part data can be commercially sensitive.

items: An engineering BOM is identified by parent part number, revision and BOM view.
Each line shows child part, quantity, unit and find number or reference designator.
Confused with the manufacturing BOM, the as-built record, a parts catalog and a software BOM.
Wrong quantity or unit causing shortages or wrong assembly.
Superseded part used because effectivity was misread.
Infinite recursion or duplicate counting in poorly formed trees.
Undeclared restricted substances through unlisted components.
IPC-2581 for printed circuit assembly data.

properties.reason: A bill of materials is a structure record; component types and parts carry the physical properties.
